atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
rangeLen = input(20, "Range Length", 5, 100, 1)
coilLookback = input(50, "Coil Lookback", 10, 150, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "Vol of Vol Length", 5, 60, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.75, "Coil Threshold", 0.5, 0.95, 0.05)
vovRiseBars = input(3, "VoV Rise Bars", 1, 10, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.0, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
tr = max(tr1, max(tr2, tr3))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
r = high - low
rangeMean = sma(r, rangeLen)
rangeMeanSafe = max(rangeMean, 0.000000001)
atrSafe = max(atrVal, 0.000000001)
highestAtr = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
lowestAtr = lowest(atrVal, coilLookback)
atrDen = max(highestAtr - lowestAtr, 0.000000001)
atrPos = (highestAtr - atrVal) / atrDen
highestR = highest(rangeMean, coilLookback)
lowestR = lowest(rangeMean, coilLookback)
rDen = max(highestR - lowestR, 0.000000001)
rPos = (highestR - rangeMean) / rDen
coil = (atrPos + rPos) / 2
atrMean = sma(atrVal, vovLen)
atrMeanSafe = max(atrMean, 0.000000001)
atrSd = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = atrSd / atrMeanSafe
vovRising = vov > vov[vovRiseBars]
oneBar = abs(close - close[1])
moveSum = sma(oneBar, predictLen) * predictLen
moveSumSafe = max(moveSum, 0.000000001)
disp = abs(close - close[predictLen])
effRaw = disp / moveSumSafe
eff = min(effRaw, 1.0)
exp = r / rangeMeanSafe
atrExp = tr / atrSafe
buySig = coil > coilThresh and vovRising and exp > releaseMult and close > open
sellSig = coil > coilThresh and vovRising and exp > releaseMult and close < open
buyFire = buySig and not buySig[1]
sellFire = sellSig and not sellSig[1]
isPredictable = eff > 0.5
buyColor = isPredictable ? "#22cc88" : "#7de3b8"
sellColor = isPredictable ? "#ff4477" : "#ff9db4"
vovPlot = vov + (buyFire or sellFire ? exp : 0)

if buyFire { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Release Buy", "triangleup", buyColor) }
if sellFire { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release Sell", "triangledown", sellColor) }
if buyFire and isPredictable { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Rel Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 2, "separate") }
if buyFire and not isPredictable { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Rel Buy", "coneup", "#7de3b8", 0.7 * markerSize, 2, "separate") }
if sellFire and isPredictable { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Rel Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 2, "separate") }
if sellFire and not isPredictable { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Rel Sell", "conedown", "#ff9db4", 0.7 * markerSize, 2, "separate") }
if coil > coilThresh and vovRising { bgcolor("#1c2f45") }
if coil > coilThresh and not vovRising { bgcolor("#16202e") }
if coil > 0.5 and coil <= coilThresh { bgcolor("#121a26") }

plot(coil, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(eff, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
hline(coilThresh, "#888888", "separate")
hline(0.5, "#444444", "separate")
plot3d(coil, "Coil Load 3D", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(eff, "Predictability 3D", "trail", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)
plot3d(vovPlot, "VoV Release Spike", "bars3d", "#ff4477", "separate", 2)

sessLen = input(20, "Session Length", 10, 200, 1)
structLook = input(3, "1H Structure Lookback", 1, 5, 1)
confThresh = input(60, "Confidence Threshold for Action", 0, 100, 1)
stopTicks = input(30, "Hard Stop Distance in Ticks", 1, 500, 1)
useOppExit = input(true, "Use Opposite Extreme Exit")
ticksize = input(0.01, "Tick Size", 0.0001, 100, 0.0001)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClosePrev = htfClose[1]
htfHighPrev = htfHigh[1]
htfLowPrev = htfLow[1]

bullStructure = htfClose > htfHighPrev and htfLow > htfLowPrev
bearStructure = htfClose < htfLowPrev and htfHigh < htfHighPrev

bc1 = htfClose > htfClose[1] ? 1 : 0
bc2 = htfClose[1] > htfClose[2] ? 1 : 0
bc3 = htfClose[2] > htfClose[3] ? 1 : 0
bc4 = htfClose[3] > htfClose[4] ? 1 : 0
bc5 = htfClose[4] > htfClose[5] ? 1 : 0
bullStreak = bc1 + bc2 + bc3 + bc4 + bc5
sc1 = htfClose < htfClose[1] ? 1 : 0
sc2 = htfClose[1] < htfClose[2] ? 1 : 0
sc3 = htfClose[2] < htfClose[3] ? 1 : 0
sc4 = htfClose[3] < htfClose[4] ? 1 : 0
sc5 = htfClose[4] < htfClose[5] ? 1 : 0
bearStreak = sc1 + sc2 + sc3 + sc4 + sc5
bullConsecutive = bullStreak >= structLook
bearConsecutive = bearStreak >= structLook

htfRange = htfHigh - htfLow
htfRangePrev = htfHighPrev - htfLowPrev
rangeExpand = htfRange > htfRangePrev

bullDist = htfClose - htfLow
bullTopHalf = htfRange > 0 and bullDist > htfRange * 0.5
bearDist = htfHigh - htfClose
bearTopHalf = htfRange > 0 and bearDist > htfRange * 0.5

bullBonus1 = bullConsecutive ? 20 : 0
bullBonus2 = rangeExpand ? 15 : 0
bullBonus3 = bullTopHalf ? 15 : 0
bullScore = 50 + bullBonus1 + bullBonus2 + bullBonus3
bearBonus1 = bearConsecutive ? 20 : 0
bearBonus2 = rangeExpand ? 15 : 0
bearBonus3 = bearTopHalf ? 15 : 0
bearScore = 50 + bearBonus1 + bearBonus2 + bearBonus3

hardStopLongCalc = close - stopTicks * ticksize
hardStopShortCalc = close + stopTicks * ticksize

var posLong = 0
var posShort = 0
var longStop = 0.0
var shortStop = 0.0

longWas = posLong[1]
shortWas = posShort[1]
longStopPrev = longStop[1]
shortStopPrev = shortStop[1]

breakHigh = crossover(close, sessHighPrev)
breakLow = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev)
buySig = breakHigh and bullStructure and bullScore >= confThresh and longWas == 0
sellSig = breakLow and bearStructure and bearScore >= confThresh and shortWas == 0

longStopHit = longWas == 1 and low <= longStopPrev
shortStopHit = shortWas == 1 and high >= shortStopPrev
longRangeExit = longWas == 1 and crossunder(close, sessLowPrev)
shortRangeExit = shortWas == 1 and crossover(close, sessHighPrev)
longOppExit = longWas == 1 and useOppExit and sellSig
shortOppExit = shortWas == 1 and useOppExit and buySig
longExitSig = longWas == 1 and (longRangeExit or longStopHit or longOppExit)
shortExitSig = shortWas == 1 and (shortRangeExit or shortStopHit or shortOppExit)

if buySig {
    model.confidence(bullScore / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopTicks * ticksize, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege-long")
    posLong := 1
    posShort := 0
    longStop := hardStopLongCalc
    shortStop := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    alert("Siege Buy")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(bearScore / 100)
    model.stopLoss(stopTicks * ticksize, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege-short")
    posShort := 1
    posLong := 0
    shortStop := hardStopShortCalc
    longStop := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    alert("Siege Sell")
}
if longExitSig {
    model.longExit("siege-long")
    model.exit("siege-long-exit")
    posLong := 0
    longStop := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Long Exit", "xcross", "#ffcc00")
    alert("Siege Long Exit")
}
if shortExitSig {
    model.shortExit("siege-short")
    model.exit("siege-short-exit")
    posShort := 0
    shortStop := 0.0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Short Exit", "xcross", "#ffcc00")
    alert("Siege Short Exit")
}

activeStop = posLong == 1 ? longStop : posShort == 1 ? shortStop : close
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(activeStop, "Hard Stop", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
